means: Fills with no shading at all - each region is one solid tone, edge to edge. The extreme end of cel logic: not two tones and a terminator, one tone and none.
does: Strips modelling out of skin and cloth and leaves the outline carrying the entire drawing. Reads graphic, poster-like, deliberately cheap. SPELLING MATTERS: the trained danbooru tag is the American 'flat color', which is what studio/cards/anime_draw_shading_steps.json uses for its flat_0 panel ('flat color, no shading'). The British spelling is a different token sequence and lands weaker - write the American form in the actual prompt even if the glossary and the UI say colour.
reach_for_it: title cards, eyecatches, silhouette beats and comedy inserts - anywhere you want the frame to stop pretending to be lit
used_in: anime.draw.shading_steps/flat_0 ('flat color, no shading') and the anime.bg.style/cel_flat clause
